title: Imperial Propaganda
caption: Imperial Propaganda (V)
game_text: If you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose Force during opponent’s control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card), that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1).
lore: Imperial data transmissions depict Rebel incursions as terrorist acts. The Alliance is portrayed as a danger to civilians of the Empire.
